body:
I am a very experienced drug user I have experimented with Marijuana, Cocaine, MDMA, LSD, Mushrooms, DMT, Methylone (bk-MDMA), 4MMC, 2CE, 2CI, 2CP, 25I Nbome, 25C Nbome, 4ACO-DMT, Crack, Oxycodone and Xanax.  Recently I got arrested so I was put on probation and I get drug tested randomly. I heard about spice before, how it doesnt show up in drug tests but Ive also heard its made a lot of people go crazy. Not really caring about that I just wanted to get high so a friend comes over and brings me 3 grams of Spice Platinum Caution Brand. I save it for the weekend, my girlfriend L comes over to my house since I cant leave my residence. So we decided to drop Methylone (bk-MDMA) we both scale out 500mg each and drop at around 11:00pm.
11:30pm- We start feeling the effects come up, Its a little bit too overwhelming my eyes starting to roll back and a feeling of peace is coming up on me. We decided to lay on my bed and give each other massages. My mind for some reason gets very spaced out on the come up of a large dose of Methylone.
12:00am- We are rolling very hard I am extremely horny and so is L. We start kissing which is amazing and can go on forever.  L wants to give me oral sex, as a male it's very hard to get an erection on Methylone but oral sex seems to do the trick, sex is amazing I now remember why I love this drug.
2:00am- Im feeling pretty good but my roll is dying out so me and L go outside to smoke a cigarette.  I tell her Im going to the gas station to buy a dutch.  L tells me not to because I can get arrested for leaving the house.  I go anyways because I am feeling like a boss ;) I come back to my house and decide to roll a blunt of spice a fat one too. Ive smoked weed when Ive been on MDMA or bk-MDMA and it always gives my roll a huge boost.
Ive smoked weed when Ive been on MDMA or bk-MDMA and it always gives my roll a huge boost.
2:30am- I finish rolling the blunt and decided to go light it. Now when I'm rolling I cant feel the smoke which is the reason I can kill a cigarette in one shot so I take 3 big pulls and hold them in. I tell L to do the same. I turn off the blunt and head back inside, we lay on the bed and start kissing and thats when its starts hitting us. My heart beat is racing Im feeling very spaced out I am feeling very dissociative my mind is somewhere else. L is also feeling like this I can see the fear in her eyes. I grab her and tell her its ok babe dont worry were going to be okay she looks at me and tells me I trust you babe, Im scared Im seeing a lot of weird things please dont leave me. I tell her I will never leave you. I am also getting overwhelming running thoughts and overthinking everything I feel very weird.
3:30am- The trip has gotten very intense Im seeing strong hallucinations and L is crying saying she feels like shes dying and thinking she overdosed. I tell her  Im feeling the same thing  knowing in the state of mind shes in I have to act like everything is alright which in reality I thought I was dying but I couldnt let her know that if not all chaos would break loose. So I told her that we were going to be okay to enjoy the trip and just ride it out. My heart beat is beating so intense I think its going to explode. I decide to get us some water and as Im walking to my kitchen I am in total shock in what I am seeing.  I see two creatures standing next to my door reptilian like demons. I felt like I was losing my sanity,  I turned on the kitchen lights and they were still there as vivid as day.  I was about to call 911 but I thought I have drugs in the house and Im on probation so no Im just going to ride it out. I bring water back to L and I was having trouble finding the door till I finally do. When I go inside my room L is under the covers saying shes seeing demons and evil faces, I give her water and kiss her and tell her its okay then she says to me "I can see who you really are. I knew what she meant but it tripped me out. I told her babe your alright its just a trip itll be over soon.
4:45am- I am now back to my normal state of mind and so is L.  Were both laughing and in joy that we survived that trip. Were both still rolling hard so we decide to have sex. L wants to watch porn while having sex. This amused me, Methylone always brought out the freak in her.  After sex Im feeling exhausted and Im feeling the comedown of methylone which I hate. L never gets a comedown but I always do.  But this time its not that bad we end up talking deeply about our lives and if were going stay with each other forever, rolling talk but with meaning to it.  2 hours later we fall asleep or so I think I did or maybe I just had my eyes closed.
9:00 am- We wake up feeling pretty good Im not feeling a comedown like the other times just a small headache. We take some Tylenols eat a bit of breakfast and talk about how crazy of a night it was.
Overall I think spice should be banned even though at the right dose it might be a pretty good drug, problem is we shouldve never taken so many hits and kept them in for so long, thats what I think made us trip out bad

.  I will try it again since I have 3 grams left, I just have to be strong minded like on any psychedelic.
Does it compare to weed? No it does not its much more of a trip than a high nothing can compare to weed Its basically weed effects to a max but with hallucinations.
